Implemented a complete Vietnamese-language survival strategy game in `index.html`.

You can scavenge for scrap, food, and fuel; build and upgrade fortifications, watchtowers, and barracks; recruit mercenaries with different combat stats; treat wounded soldiers; and manage rations and morale. Raids arrive every four days, and the campaign is to survive 30 days until rescue. Progress is saved in the browser.

The interface is responsive and uses original canvas-drawn 2D pixel-inspired artwork. I verified the game loads, tested scavenging, advancing days, recruitment, and treatment, and checked the mobile layout.

Assumptions: a single-player campaign, two orders per day, and increasingly dangerous periodic attacks.
